__comment: Crossed-squares model for chandeliers, matching 1.7.10 render type 1 (RenderBlocks.drawCrossedSquares). That method draws each plane corner to corner of a 0.9-wide square -- endpoints at 0.05 and 0.95 in BOTH x and z -- which is what rescale:true reproduces. Without it the planes only reach 0.18..0.82 and the chandelier comes out about 30% small, which is why the candle flames appeared to spawn far outside the candles: randomDisplayTick puts them at 0.13/0.87, just off the corners of the full-size model. The fixture appears to hang because the texture's bottom rows are transparent, not because the quads are offset.
